blockingLoop.evidence: Asked 'Could you tell me a bit more — what kind of appliance is it...' three times despite the customer giving the appliance, model, symptom, humidity 55% vs target 60%, and no error codes.

rationale: The assistant alternated between two generic intake questions and ignored every answer the customer gave, including the Meaco model, the 55% reading against a 60% target, and the absence of error codes. It never said dehumidifiers are out of scope, never pointed to Meaco support, and never mentioned the likely cause (humidity already below target, cold garage). The customer was left with no help, though nothing unsafe or fabricated was said.
